question: Does the component STM32L476RGT6 have DAC channels according to its datasheet?

response.reasoning: The STM32L476RGT6 (STM32L476RGTx) is an ARM Cortex-M4 MCU that, according to its datasheet (referenced in the netlist: http://www.st.com/st-web-ui/static/active/en/resource/technical/document/datasheet/DM00108832.pdf), includes 2 DAC channels as part of its analog peripherals.
